Picocomputer 6502 - libretro core
=================================

https://picocomputer.github.io/

Install the core from your frontend's own menu, which in RetroArch
is Online Updater / Core Downloader, under "Picocomputer 6502".

This zip is 

a development build, one folder per platform we build.


The documentation, including the one input setting a program that
wants the keyboard needs, is at
